newsitem.title: NORWAY: Industry shares push Norway index to life peak.
newsitem.headline: Industry shares push Norway index to life peak.

text.p: Industry shares led by industrial giant Norsk Hydro helped push the Norwegian Total stock index to an all-time closing high on Tuesday.
The crown also stayed strong and interest rates low as the Total index finished at 892.39, up 0.14 percent on Monday's closing figure as the bourse remained bullish.
Turnover was a healthy 763 million crowns.
Hydro, forestry group Norske Skogindustrier, offshore construction group Aker and Petroleum Geo-Services all closed higher to help lift the index.

Shipbuilder and engineering group Kvaerner fell sharply the morning after reporting disappointing nine-month profits. Both the A and B class shares regained some ground but they finished in negative territory.
"Otherwise things are looking very strong and that makes me a bit sceptical," said one dealer asked about the direction in the next few days.
